title: Paper
description: Physical paper as a 3D sheet: a receipt that unrolls, a letter that folds, a corner that peels, a page that turns, with stocks, printed content and interaction states.
changeNotice: Modified by Design From Labs: the modules of Paperlab's <Paper> are one file each with flat names (paper-*), imports follow; GSAP tweens are rewritten with Motion (paper-ease.ts); the canvas is drawn through render-loop with the flat fallback layered over it until the first frame. Every change is listed in docs/evidence/ports/paper/fidelity.md of github.com/Design-from-labs/labs.

props.name: preset
props.description: A named preset (receipt-unroll, paper-roll, letter-fold, washed-letter, vintage-note, hero-peel, page-flip, hanging-poster, pinned-sheet, flying-note, blank-sheet, postage-stamp, photo-print, crumpled-note, paper-ribbon, settled-sheet, typed-note, peeling-sticker...) or a full config.

props.name: sheet / stock / content
props.description: The sheet's size, its paper stock (thermal, kraft, vellum...), and what is printed on it (receipt, card, typed text, an image, a wash); each overrides the preset.

props.name: behavior
props.description: What the sheet does, with its progress (0 to 1) and parameters; a fixed progress gives a still.

props.name: autoplay
props.description: Plays the behavior on a loop (not under reduced motion).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lets the pointer drag the behavior's handles (peel a corner, pull the receipt).

props.name: surface / states / onProgress / reducedMotion
props.description: Deckle edges, creases and damage; hover and press states with transitions; progress callbacks; a reduced-motion override.

props.name: ref
props.description: play(), pause(), playing, set(param, value), getProgress(), snapshot(), toJSON().

a11y: The sheet's text is mirrored in hidden DOM for assistive technology (PaperMirror), and the static fallback is role="img" with that text as its name.
Without WebGL, and until the first frame is drawn (the server render), a flat picture of the sheet shows instead of the canvas.
Under prefers-reduced-motion the sheet stays still: no autoplay, as upstream; drawing stops off screen and in hidden tabs (render-loop), with the pixel ratio capped at 2.
docs:
Installed `Paper` in `components/ui/` (seventy-five files, all prefixed `paper`), with the `render-loop` helper in `lib/` and `use-reduced-motion` in `hooks/`. It fills its parent, so give the parent a height: `
`. Pick a preset (receipt-unroll, letter-fold, hero-peel, page-flip, crumpled-note...) and override `content`, `stock`, `sheet` or `behavior`; a fixed `behavior.progress` gives a still. Needs `three`, `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei`, `three-custom-shader-material`, `zod` and `motion` (installed) and, for TypeScript, `@types/three`.
